items.source_en:
Wyatt is a survivor, like myself. He has managed to stay clear of the numerous calamities. When I first knew him he was Bill Hikock. Then his next iteration he claimed he was nameless (called himself Carl), and now Wyatt. My suspicion is the Facility is doing some extensive experiment with feeding him new IDs and then seeing what happens.

I like this version the best. I mean, clearly he isn't Wyatt Earp (and I had my doubts about Bill Hikock) - but he's friendly and helpful. And almost all of us have used his rooms to sleep something off at one point or another. Maybe he's just a pathological liar?

items.source_en:
To Sleep, by John Keats

O soft embalmer of the still midnight,
      Shutting, with careful fingers and benign,
Our gloom-pleas'd eyes, embower'd from the light,
      Enshaded in forgetfulness divine:
O soothest Sleep! if so it please thee, close
      In midst of this thine hymn my willing eyes,
Or wait the "Amen," ere thy poppy throws
      Around my bed its lulling charities.
Then save me, or the passed day will shine
Upon my pillow, breeding many woes,--
      Save me from curious Conscience, that still lords
Its strength for darkness, burrowing like a mole;
      Turn the key deftly in the oiled wards,
And seal the hushed Casket of my Soul.
items.legacy_ko:
잠에게, 존 키츠 작

오 고요한 한밤의 부드러운 향유를 바르는 이여,
    조심스럽고 상냥한 손끝으로 감기나니,
빛에서 가리워 어둠이 깃든 우리 눈이여,
    신성한 망각의 그림자가 드리운 것이니:
오 누그러뜨리는 잠이여! 그대를 만족시킨다면, 나의 눈을
    그댈 위한 이 찬미가의 와중에 기꺼이 감겨 주오,
외려 “아멘” 기도의 끝을 기다리오, 그대의 양귀비 앞을
    나의 잠자리 주위로 그 어르는 자선으로.
그리고 나를 구해주오, 아니면 날이 새어 비추리니,
내 베갯머리에 근심을 많이 낳고, -
    나를 호기심 많은 양심에서 구해주오. 이 주관하려
함은 어둠의 힘이니, 두더지처럼 굴을 파고;
    기름친 방에서 잰 놀림으로 열쇠를 돌려,
내 영혼의 입 닫은 관을 봉해주오.
